answer: The mesa schedule is applied in knoll and nectar shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1413 identities would post 563 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
